Data.Text.Read, its license and package manifest are retained verbatim from
https://hackage.haskell.org/package/text-2.1.2/text-2.1.2.tar.gz
(SHA-256 84a60cf59287d38e9a25910f90e9cb818e18656532034e60c9c5aaaddeceacb6).

The writer HTML oracle uses GHC 9.12.2's text-2.1.2 package. These sources document
the Integer decimal/hexadecimal reader used by Commonmark.Entity.lookupEntity,
including its optional additional 0x/0X prefix. This directory is provenance,
not an alternate production parser or a replacement oracle implementation.
